name: jellyflix
description: Standalone JavaScript add-on for the Jellyfin 12.x web client (pause info card + CSS hooks)

scripts.build:bundles: node tools/build-addon.mjs && node tools/build-addon.mjs --bundle pause-info-card --mods 10-row-tags,20-scroll-var,40-card-meta,50-pause-info --out dist/bundles/pause-info-card.js && node tools/build-addon.mjs --bundle episode-picker --mods 60-episode-picker --out dist/bundles/episode-picker.js
